hardGateFindings.finding: External reader comprehension, collaborator agreement, applications, hiring effects, production approval, and deployment outcomes remain explicitly unmeasured. Reader, outreach, and follow-through protocols are labeled planned with no returned receipts.

All eight blind spots have distinct signals, controls, triggers, owners, decision rules, next tests, and evidence-return paths. Exact-set role classifications, render-derived composition inventories, inquiry targets, source-balance reviews, and receipt state machines make failures observable.

The repository separates deterministic checking, read-only LLM judgments, orchestration provenance, and external human validation, and states that repository provenance is auditable process evidence rather than cryptographic proof. This fresh judgment did not use prior judge scores as evidence.

Record-level controls are supplemented by a current digest-bound mosaic review covering relationship, movement, platform, educational-record, reader-feedback, and expedition risks. Private feedback, raw graphs, protected locators, scans, photographs, participant records, and unnecessary identifying detail remain excluded.

limitations: This is an LLM evaluation of repository controls and public surfaces, not human hiring-reader research or field validation.

The bounded reader study, hiring-reader solicitation, and outward job-search follow-through remain planned with no returned receipts; actionability is therefore scored 4, and no external outcome is inferred.

Several public proofs retain careful or mixed evidence classifications, including contribution, coalition-role, social-identity, and participation claims; their guardrails remain necessary and broader individual-role corroboration is incomplete.
Protected evidence was assessable only through governed public-safe metadata, relationships, summaries, and boundaries, not through the underlying private artifacts.
Composition budgets and comprehension thresholds are internally specified; their real-world usefulness remains to be tested through the planned reader protocol.

The non-print deterministic checker currently reports only the known stale current-run digest and judge references that this fresh cycle is replacing; those orchestration artifacts were not treated as candidate-control defects.
